neighbours.label: the word that opens a back-reference to what was just said: 'Before' or 'After' (that), 'Other than' (that), 'get to' or 'handle' (that/those)
fire: The farm has grown wheat for years. Before that it held sheep.
I like the house. Other than that, nothing is new.
The mill closed in 1950. After that the town shrank.
My desk is by the wall. To the left of that is a lamp.
Leave the dishes for now. We'll get to those tomorrow.
You can skip the filing, because we handle that here.
Her shop opened in May. Before that she sold online.
The bike runs fine. Other than that, I have no news.
quiet: The farm has grown wheat for years. It also held sheep.
I like the house. Nothing else is new.
The mill closed in 1950. The town shrank.
My desk is by the wall. A lamp stands there.
Leave the dishes for now. We'll wash cups tomorrow.
You can skip the filing, because we work here.
Her shop opened in May. She also sold online.
The bike runs fine. I have no news.

notes: Probes: the peak sits on the setting-up word, so 'Before the war' read the same as 'Before that' (0.345). The label is about the expectation, and the pole cannot see the next word.
